match_basis: Statutory regulatory body for thoroughbred racing in NSW
evidence.evidence_summary: Racing NSW is a body corporate established under the Thoroughbred Racing Act 1996 to control, supervise and regulate thoroughbred horse racing in New South Wales. It functions as a regulator with statutory powers. The organization produces content including live racing broadcasts, race replays, and racing news available through its website, YouTube channels, and streaming platforms. It generates over $300 million in recurring annual income from wagering revenue sources including Race Fields fees, TAB distribution parity, and Point of Consumption Tax. The organization relies on wagering-related sponsorship and partnerships (particularly with Tabcorp) for revenue generation.
